answer: In a food-system agent economy, each participant stakes a crop-certificate jade token that is time-locked in a shared vault and released only against a live supply pulse signed by a rotating validator quorum. Sybil resistance emerges because a forged identity cannot borrow the pulse history or vault collateral of an established farm agent, so duplicate registrations. Colluding clusters incur an exponential slashing penalty bounded by O(Delta * S).
